text:
alex: heads-up — i pushed key-normalizer v2 to staging a few mins ago. noticed the per-route cache hit gauge moved for some long-tail customers, curious if this is a rollout artifact or a real regression:

runtime-bot: automated snapshot: model=gpt-open-11b route=/summarize hits=62.1% -> 44.8% (24h) tokens_saved=1.2M -> 870k; avg_latency +12ms

maria: pinging eng-runtime folks. can you dump the key fingerprint distribution for the affected route?

kevin: adding my quick profiler output — looks like key normalization removed punctuation and lowercased, but we also changed whitespace collapse rules. example old_key vs new_key:
```
old: "User: Hello
Context: ..."
new: "user hello context ..."
```
that can merge some similar keys but also collapse subtle prefix differences used by a few customers (they rely on role markers).

jen: hmm. i saw a similar pattern last month when we tightened kernel batching boundaries — warmup injection didn't trigger for those collapsed keys. is warmup keyed to original tokenization or to the normalized fingerprint?

kevin: warmup currently uses normalized fingerprint (post-normalizer). so if two prefixes collapse into one, warmup will warm a single entry — good for savings but bad when the collapsed key maps to multiple semantically-different prompts that expect KV variance.

maria: can you paste the dashboard query? want to slice by customer and model version.

kevin: dashboard snippet (Grafana):
```
SELECT
  model, route, customer_id,
  avg(hit_rate) as hit_rate,
  sum(tokens_saved) as tokens_saved
FROM cache_metrics
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY model, route, customer_id
ORDER BY tokens_saved desc
```

alex: quick adhoc: customer=acme_uk shows hit_rate 78% -> 41% after deploy, tokens_saved down 54k/day. other customers stable.

jen: action items i propose:
- rollback normalizer for staging and run canary rollback for acme_uk
- add a flag in normalizer to preserve role markers for routes that opt-in
- add an observability panel showing key-entropy per-customer (low entropy => risk of over-collapsing)

maria: +1. also add a token-saved timeseries by rollout cohort (v1 vs v2) so we can correlate perf regressed routes with token economics.

runtime-bot: perf note: kernel-selection latencies unchanged; batching heuristic changed slightly (fold threshold -1) in the same deploy — correlating signals for a full picture.

kevin: for immediate triage i'll: 1) re-run a fingerprint diff run on prod sample for /summarize; 2) produce per-customer key-entropy histogram; 3) run warmup simulation with collapsed keys to measure miss penalty.

alex: thanks. timeline?

kevin: will have diffs + histogram in ~90m, warmup sim in 3h. posting links when ready.

maria: leave a quick runbook note: if tokens_saved drops >20% for a top-20 customer after a keying change, flag to oncall and rollback. putting that under eng-runtime runbooks. :memo:

jen: also we should add a dashboard card: "token-economics delta by rollout" with percent change and absolute tokens/day. that helps PMs see $$ impact.

alex: sounds good. if anyone wants to pair on the rollback plan ping me. thanks all :thumbsup:
